difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the canonical map K tensor^L RSheafHom(M, L) -> RSheafHom(M, K tensor^L L) on the derived category of a ringed site (statement lines 9052-9062). The construction requires two independent resolution choices: K is represented by a K-flat complex so that the derived tensor product is computed by the naive one, and the tensor product K tensor^L I is resolved by a K-injective J so that the target internal hom can be evaluated at all (proof lines 9065-9071). Only then can the first arrow be taken from the earlier diagonal lemma and composed with the arrow induced by the quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 9071-9083). The claim is H2: one construction whose only non-formal content is the choice of resolutions and the recognition of the two represented objects.
